title: Historically Accurate Mace
description: A resource pack with one goal: giving the mace a historically accurate look.
body:
**Historically Accurate Maces** makes the mace item look like a 4-flanged mace that was actually used in battle.

- It is still a 2d item, meaning you do not need any mods to use the resource pack.
- Since the item itself is smaller than the original mace texture, it takes up less space on screen.

![Side view mace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b636dc125e4b500aebb3ee50a8f56abdf513cb88.png)
